data.name: Atharvashiras
data.gender_notes: Atharvashiras is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Atharvashiras is a name derived from the ancient Indian text, the Atharvaveda. It is believed to represent the god of the same name, who is considered the guardian of knowledge and wisdom. The name is often used to bestow the blessings of knowledge and enlightenment upon a child. The name Atharvashiras carries the meaning “Knowledge of the gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atharvashiras usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Atharvashiras belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge of the gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atharvashiras total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Atharvashiras" holds significant cultural value in India, particularly among Hindus. It is believed that invoking the name of Atharvasiras brings blessings of prosperity, good health, and knowledge. The name is also often used in Vedic rituals and ceremonies,such as samskaras, to seek the blessings of the god for the wellbeing and success of individuals and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hindu mythology, Atharvasiras is the deity of the Atharvaveda, the fourth Veda, and is believed to be the god of knowledge, wisdom, and healing. He is considered as a guiding force in troubled times and is often invoked to ward off negative influences. The spiritual significance of the name Atharvashiras lies in the belief that it represents a seeker of wisdom, knowledge, and enlightenment. The name is seen as a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in one's spiritual journey towards self-realization and liberation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Atharvashiras signifies the radiant and profound wisdom of the Atharva Veda, the fourth Veda of Hindu tradition. It symbolizes the enlightened seeker, deeply connected to the divine, shining with the knowledge of the universe.
